entries.meaningZh: 一天开始时吃的第一餐。
entries.en: We ate breakfast on the balcony while the harbour slowly woke up.
entries.zh: 我们在阳台上吃早餐，此时港口正慢慢苏醒。

entries.meaningZh: 具有独立法律身份的公司组织。
entries.en: The corporation owns several factories but keeps its headquarters in this town.
entries.zh: 这家公司拥有几家工厂，但总部仍设在这个镇上。

entries.meaningZh: 构成基础、不可缺少的。
entries.en: Trust is fundamental to any partnership that must survive difficult decisions.
entries.zh: 对于需要经受艰难决定考验的合作关系而言，信任是基础。

entries.meaningZh: 几乎完全地，接近某种状态。
entries.en: By midnight, the snow had made the mountain road virtually impassable.
entries.zh: 到了午夜，积雪已使那条山路几乎无法通行。

entries.meaningZh: 完全符合要求或没有问题地。
entries.en: The old camera still works perfectly despite the scratches on its case.
entries.zh: 尽管外壳上有划痕，那台旧相机仍然运转正常。

entries.meaningZh: 不同于通常情况的。
entries.en: An unusual blue mushroom was growing beside the fallen tree.
entries.zh: 倒下的树旁长着一朵不常见的蓝色蘑菇。

entries.meaningZh: 不符合一般规则的特殊情况。
entries.en: Everyone arrived by train, with the exception of our cycling instructor.
entries.zh: 除了我们的骑行教练以外，所有人都是坐火车来的。

entries.meaningZh: 允许从事某项活动的正式证件。
entries.en: Please bring your driving licence when you collect the rental car.
entries.zh: 领取租来的汽车时，请带上你的驾驶执照。

entries.meaningZh: 停止继续某项计划或行动。
entries.en: We had to abandon the picnic when thunder echoed across the lake.
entries.zh: 雷声在湖面上回荡时，我们只好放弃野餐。

entries.meaningZh: 把材料或部件组合起来建造。
entries.en: The pupils will construct a small bridge using cardboard and string.
entries.zh: 学生们将用硬纸板和绳子搭建一座小桥。

entries.meaningZh: 为了获胜或取得机会而竞争。
entries.en: Three local bakers will compete for the festival's best pastry award.
entries.zh: 三位当地面包师将角逐节庆活动的最佳糕点奖。

entries.meaningZh: 为弄清事实而进行的正式调查。
entries.en: The inquiry examined why the emergency doors had remained locked.
entries.zh: 这项调查研究了紧急出口的门为何一直锁着。

entries.meaningZh: 移居另一个国家生活的人。
entries.en: As a young immigrant, Lena found friendship through the neighbourhood choir.
entries.zh: 莉娜作为一名年轻移民，通过社区合唱团结交了朋友。

entries.meaningZh: 使一个人与别人不同的性格特点。
entries.en: His quiet personality suits a job that requires patient observation.
entries.zh: 他安静的性格适合需要耐心观察的工作。

entries.meaningZh: 程度严重地。
entries.en: The kitchen ceiling was badly damaged when the upstairs pipe burst.
entries.zh: 楼上的水管爆裂时，厨房天花板遭到了严重损坏。

entries.meaningZh: 帮助别人完成事情或应对困难。
entries.en: Passengers needing assistance can contact the station team before their journey.
entries.zh: 需要帮助的乘客可以在出行前联系车站工作人员。

entries.meaningZh: 组合起来表达一个意思的一组词。
entries.en: The phrase in the final paragraph gives the speech a hopeful ending.
entries.zh: 最后一段中的那个短语为这篇演讲带来了充满希望的结尾。

entries.meaningZh: 某种东西有多少的数额或分量。
entries.en: Use a small quantity of water to loosen the dried paint.
entries.zh: 用少量水把干了的颜料调稀。

entries.meaningZh: 尚未被知道或查明的。
entries.en: The sender's address is unknown, so we cannot return the parcel.
entries.zh: 寄件人的地址不明，因此我们无法退回包裹。

entries.meaningZh: 不经人工处理而自然地。
entries.en: The fabric dries naturally in the breeze without a heated dryer.
entries.zh: 这种布料在微风中自然晾干，无需使用加热烘干机。

entries.meaningZh: 按照安排继续进行。
entries.en: Once the lights turn green, you may proceed through the gate.
entries.zh: 灯变绿后，你就可以继续穿过大门。

entries.meaningZh: 用纸、布等把东西包起来。
entries.en: Could you wrap the glass bowl in a thick towel?
entries.zh: 你能用一条厚毛巾把玻璃碗包起来吗？

entries.meaningZh: 为之后的活动提前做的安排或练习。
entries.en: Careful preparation helped the actors handle an unexpected change of venue.
entries.zh: 充分的准备帮助演员们应对了演出场地的突然变更。

entries.meaningZh: 人际之间紧张不安的气氛。
entries.en: A shared joke eased the tension around the crowded dinner table.
entries.zh: 大家一起说笑，缓和了拥挤餐桌旁的紧张气氛。

entries.meaningZh: 经济活动长期严重低迷的时期。
entries.en: The novel follows a farming family during a severe economic depression.
entries.zh: 这部小说讲述了一个农户家庭在严重经济萧条时期的经历。

entries.meaningZh: 与内心、信仰或精神生活有关的。
entries.en: For him, tending the garden offers spiritual comfort after a difficult week.
entries.zh: 对他来说，艰难的一周过后照料花园能带来精神慰藉。

entries.meaningZh: 结合歌曲、表演和舞蹈的舞台剧。
entries.en: My sister designed the costumes for our school's spring musical.
entries.zh: 我姐姐为学校的春季音乐剧设计了服装。

entries.meaningZh: 等于一百厘米的长度单位，即米。
entries.en: Leave a metre between the seedlings so their branches have room.
entries.zh: 幼苗之间留出一米距离，让枝条有生长空间。

entries.meaningZh: 由奶加工而成的固体食品，即奶酪。
entries.en: She scattered grated cheese over the soup just before serving it.
entries.zh: 她在上汤前往汤上撒了些奶酪碎。

entries.meaningZh: 用薄纸卷住烟草制成的香烟。
entries.en: He put out his cigarette before approaching the petrol pump.
entries.zh: 他在走近加油泵之前熄灭了香烟。

entries.meaningZh: 用来补充一个支持前文的理由，表示而且。
entries.en: The room overlooks the park; moreover, its rent includes heating.
entries.zh: 这个房间可以俯瞰公园，而且租金包含暖气费。

entries.meaningZh: 用面粉制成面团后烘烤的食品。
entries.en: The bakery sells yesterday's bread cheaply to reduce food waste.
entries.zh: 这家面包店低价出售前一天的面包，以减少食物浪费。

entries.meaningZh: 在某件事之后发生的。
entries.en: The first test failed, but subsequent trials produced much clearer results.
entries.zh: 第一次测试失败了，但后续试验得出了清晰得多的结果。

entries.meaningZh: 完成规定课程并获得毕业资格。
entries.en: Maya hopes to graduate next summer and join her family's business.
entries.zh: 玛雅希望明年夏天毕业，然后加入家族企业。

entries.meaningZh: 与议会及其工作有关的。
entries.en: The journalist waited outside while the parliamentary committee questioned the minister.
entries.zh: 议会委员会向部长提问时，那名记者在外面等候。

entries.meaningZh: 人在特定情境中产生的内心感受。
entries.en: Relief was the strongest emotion I felt after finding my passport.
entries.zh: 找到护照后，我最强烈的感受就是如释重负。

entries.meaningZh: 因害怕、疼痛等发出的尖叫声。
entries.en: A sudden scream from the playground made every parent turn around.
entries.zh: 游乐场突然传来一声尖叫，所有家长都转过头去。

entries.meaningZh: 包含全部空间、物质和天体的整体。
entries.en: The exhibition asks how humans came to understand their place in the universe.
entries.zh: 这个展览探讨人类如何逐渐理解自己在宇宙中的位置。

entries.meaningZh: 对事物作出改变。
entries.en: Adding a second window would alter the appearance of the whole room.
entries.zh: 再加一扇窗户会改变整个房间的样貌。

entries.meaningZh: 发生次数很少地。
entries.en: We rarely see foxes here, though their tracks appear every winter.
entries.zh: 我们在这里很少看见狐狸，但每年冬天都会发现它们的足迹。

entries.meaningZh: 把谷物磨成粉的作坊或设施。
entries.en: The village mill once used river water to turn its heavy stones.
entries.zh: 村里的磨坊曾利用河水转动沉重的磨石。

entries.meaningZh: 高而相对狭窄的建筑物。
entries.en: From the tower, visitors can see fishing boats beyond the harbour wall.
entries.zh: 从塔上，游客可以看到港口防波堤外的渔船。

entries.meaningZh: 指属于你或你们的人或物。
entries.en: These gloves look like yours, but the label has another name.
entries.zh: 这副手套看起来像你的，但标签上写着另一个名字。

entries.meaningZh: 穿在其他衣服外面保暖的外套。
entries.en: I left my wool coat hanging beside the restaurant entrance.
entries.zh: 我把羊毛外套留在餐厅入口旁边挂着。

entries.meaningZh: 帮助改善身体或心理问题的治疗。
entries.en: During therapy, he practised movements needed to return to his work.
entries.zh: 治疗期间，他练习了重返工作所需的动作。

entries.meaningZh: 有害物质进入环境造成的污染。
entries.en: The students measured air pollution beside the school and in a park.
entries.zh: 学生们测量了学校旁边和一座公园里的空气污染情况。

entries.meaningZh: 规定国家基本制度和权利的根本法律。
entries.en: The class compared how each constitution describes the powers of government.
entries.zh: 全班比较了各部宪法如何规定政府的权力。

entries.meaningZh: 把计划或决定付诸实际行动。
entries.en: The library will implement the new borrowing rules after the holidays.
entries.zh: 图书馆将在假期结束后实行新的借阅规定。

entries.meaningZh: 携带遗传信息的基本单位，即基因。
entries.en: The textbook uses a diagram to explain how a gene is copied.
entries.zh: 课本用一张示意图解释基因是如何被复制的。

entries.meaningZh: 以铁为主要成分的坚硬合金，即钢。
entries.en: The sculpture combines polished steel with pieces of weathered driftwood.
entries.zh: 这座雕塑把抛光钢材与几块饱经风吹日晒的浮木结合在一起。

entries.meaningZh: 等于2.54厘米的长度单位，即英寸。
entries.en: The shelf is an inch too wide for this narrow cupboard.
entries.zh: 这个搁板对这个狭窄的柜子来说宽了一英寸。

entries.meaningZh: 具有强大破坏力或冲击力的。
entries.en: A violent storm tore several branches from the old chestnut tree.
entries.zh: 一场猛烈的暴风雨折断了那棵老栗树的几根树枝。

entries.meaningZh: 一个人区别于他人的自身身份、个性或本质。
entries.en: Writing in a diary helped her develop a stronger sense of self.
entries.zh: 写日记帮助她建立了更强的自我意识。

entries.meaningZh: 靠脚蹬踏板前进的两轮交通工具。
entries.en: Someone had chained a yellow bike to the railings outside our office.
entries.zh: 有人把一辆黄色自行车锁在了我们办公室外的栏杆上。

entries.meaningZh: 供船只停泊和装卸货物的港口。
entries.en: The ship reached port before the fog covered the entire coast.
entries.zh: 那艘船在浓雾笼罩整个海岸之前抵达了港口。

entries.meaningZh: 覆盖表面或夹在其他部分之间的一层。
entries.en: A thin layer of ice covered the puddles along the path.
entries.zh: 小路沿途的水坑上覆盖着一层薄冰。

entries.meaningZh: 找到办法解决问题或分歧。
entries.en: The neighbours met over coffee to resolve their disagreement about the fence.
entries.zh: 邻居们边喝咖啡边见面，解决他们对围栏的分歧。

entries.meaningZh: 沿着表面平滑地移动。
entries.en: You can slide the drawer out completely to clean behind it.
entries.zh: 你可以把抽屉完全滑出来，清洁它后面的地方。

entries.meaningZh: 覆盖脚和部分小腿的靴子。
entries.en: A sharp stone had become lodged in the sole of my boot.
entries.zh: 一块尖石卡进了我的靴底。

entries.meaningZh: 两个人正式结婚时举行的仪式或庆祝活动。
entries.en: They held their wedding in the garden where they first met.
entries.zh: 他们在初次相遇的花园里举行了婚礼。

entries.meaningZh: 在比赛或争论中与自己对抗的人。
entries.en: My opponent offered a handshake after our long and exhausting chess match.
entries.zh: 那场漫长而耗费精力的国际象棋比赛结束后，我的对手主动与我握手。

entries.meaningZh: 以精炼语言和节奏表达感受的文学作品。
entries.en: The poem describes a winter morning through the eyes of a child.
entries.zh: 这首诗通过一个孩子的视角描写了一个冬日清晨。

entries.meaningZh: 涉及范围很广或数量很大的。
entries.en: The building needs extensive repairs before any families can move back in.
entries.zh: 这栋楼需要大规模维修，住户才能搬回来。

entries.meaningZh: 使外貌、性质或用途发生显著变化。
entries.en: Fresh paint and better lighting can transform a dark basement.
entries.zh: 新刷的油漆和更好的照明能让昏暗的地下室焕然一新。

entries.meaningZh: 与种植作物或饲养牲畜有关的。
entries.en: The museum displays agricultural tools once used on nearby farms.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了附近农场曾经使用过的农具。

entries.meaningZh: 酒类饮品中能使人醉的成分，即酒精。
entries.en: The label states that this sparkling drink contains no alcohol.
entries.zh: 标签上注明，这款起泡饮料不含酒精。

entries.meaningZh: 短暂而迅速的一看。
entries.en: A quick glance at the departure board confirmed that our train was delayed.
entries.zh: 匆匆看了一眼出发时刻显示屏后，我们确认火车晚点了。

entries.meaningZh: 构成生物组织并参与多种生命活动的物质，即蛋白质。
entries.en: For her science project, Eva compared the protein content of several foods.
entries.zh: 在科学课题中，伊娃比较了几种食物的蛋白质含量。

entries.meaningZh: 用来指出与另一个人或事物不同。
entries.en: This path stays dry in winter, unlike the muddy route through the woods.
entries.zh: 这条小路冬天仍然干燥，不像穿过树林的那条路那么泥泞。

entries.meaningZh: 根据自己的判断认为或估计。
entries.en: I reckon we can finish the roof before the next rainstorm.
entries.zh: 我估计我们能在下一场暴雨之前把屋顶做完。

entries.meaningZh: 岩石碎成的细小颗粒，常见于海滩。
entries.en: The children dug a channel through the sand to the sea.
entries.zh: 孩子们在沙地里挖了一条通向大海的水道。

entries.meaningZh: 保护某物，使其保持原有状态。
entries.en: The archive keeps letters in special boxes to preserve their fragile paper.
entries.zh: 档案馆把信件存放在专用盒子中，以保护脆弱的纸张。

entries.meaningZh: 通常需要专门知识或训练的职业。
entries.en: She entered the teaching profession after several years as an engineer.
entries.zh: 她做了几年工程师之后，进入了教师行业。

entries.meaningZh: 从一种状态转向另一种状态的过程。
entries.en: A mentor helped ease his transition from university into full-time employment.
entries.zh: 一位导师帮助他更顺利地从大学过渡到全职工作。

entries.meaningZh: 使受损或变差的东西恢复原状。
entries.en: Specialists hope to restore the faded colours without damaging the original paint.
entries.zh: 专家希望在不损坏原有颜料的情况下恢复褪去的颜色。

entries.meaningZh: 位于某人或某物的对面。
entries.en: We found a small café opposite the main entrance to the museum.
entries.zh: 我们在博物馆正门对面找到了一家小咖啡馆。

entries.meaningZh: 对某项计划或行为的正式同意。
entries.en: The organisers need written approval before using the school sports field.
entries.zh: 组织者在使用学校运动场之前需要获得书面批准。

entries.meaningZh: 通常位于乡间的小住宅。
entries.en: Their stone cottage has a low doorway and roses around the windows.
entries.zh: 他们的石头小屋门口低矮，窗户周围种着玫瑰。

entries.meaningZh: 在不同时间保持相近水平或表现的。
entries.en: Her consistent attendance made her a reliable member of the rehearsal team.
entries.zh: 她始终如一地参加排练，成了排练团队中可靠的一员。

entries.meaningZh: 负责管理学校的校长。
entries.en: The principal welcomed new pupils at the assembly on Monday morning.
entries.zh: 校长在星期一早晨的集会上欢迎了新同学。

entries.meaningZh: 对某项改变或要求的反对。
entries.en: The proposal met strong resistance from residents worried about losing their park.
entries.zh: 这项提议遭到了居民的强烈反对，他们担心会失去公园。

entries.meaningZh: 处于某种环境或影响之下的状态。
entries.en: Long exposure to rain had ruined the books inside the shed.
entries.zh: 长期受雨水侵袭，棚子里的书都损坏了。

entries.meaningZh: 引起问题或带来某种困难。
entries.en: The narrow staircase could pose a problem when we move the piano.
entries.zh: 我们搬钢琴时，狭窄的楼梯可能会造成困难。

entries.meaningZh: 别人长期形成的对某人或事物的评价。
entries.en: The café built its reputation on friendly service and excellent homemade cakes.
entries.zh: 这家咖啡馆凭借友好的服务和出色的自制蛋糕赢得了好名声。

entries.meaningZh: 很有用或值得珍惜的。
entries.en: Your notes provide valuable details that the official photographs do not show.
entries.zh: 你的笔记提供了官方照片没有呈现的宝贵细节。

entries.meaningZh: 见面或开始交谈时使用的问候语。
entries.en: I heard someone call, 'Well, hello, stranger!' from across the courtyard.
entries.zh: 我听见有人在院子对面喊：“哎，你好呀，稀客！”

entries.meaningZh: 讲述真实或虚构事件的故事。
entries.en: Grandfather told a strange tale about a boat that sailed without anyone aboard.
entries.zh: 祖父讲了个奇怪的故事，说一艘船在无人乘坐时自行航行。

entries.meaningZh: 为共同目标暂时联合起来的团体。
entries.en: A coalition of local charities opened a shelter during the cold weather.
entries.zh: 寒冷天气期间，一个由当地慈善机构组成的联盟开设了收容所。

entries.meaningZh: 在本国以外的国家或前往那里。
entries.en: She spent a year abroad learning how small coastal towns manage tourism.
entries.zh: 她在国外待了一年，学习沿海小镇如何管理旅游业。

entries.meaningZh: 与人们被归属的种族有关的。
entries.en: The workshop examined racial stereotypes in old advertisements and school textbooks.
entries.zh: 这场研讨活动考察了旧广告和学校课本中的种族刻板印象。

entries.meaningZh: 一种银白色的贵金属，即银。
entries.en: The jeweller shaped a thin strip of silver into a simple ring.
entries.zh: 珠宝匠把一条薄银片加工成了一枚简洁的戒指。

entries.meaningZh: 城镇以外有田野和村落的地区。
entries.en: We hired bicycles to explore the countryside beyond the busy seaside town.
entries.zh: 我们租了自行车，去探索繁忙海滨小镇以外的乡间。

entries.meaningZh: 表明身体可能出现疾病的表现。
entries.en: The nurse asked which symptom had first made him seek help.
entries.zh: 护士问他，最初是什么症状让他前来求助。

entries.meaningZh: 发生得很快而没有预兆的。
entries.en: A sudden gust lifted the picnic blanket and scattered our paper plates.
entries.zh: 一阵突如其来的风掀起野餐毯，吹散了我们的纸盘。

entries.meaningZh: 由一个统治中心控制多个地区的国家体系。
entries.en: The map shows how the empire expanded along rivers and trade routes.
entries.zh: 这幅地图展示了那个帝国如何沿着河流和商路扩张。

entries.meaningZh: 夏季之后、冬季之前的季节，即秋天。
entries.en: Every autumn, the lane disappears beneath a carpet of golden leaves.
entries.zh: 每到秋天，那条小路都会被厚厚的金色落叶覆盖。

entries.meaningZh: 对知识、存在和价值等根本问题的研究。
entries.en: Studying philosophy taught her to question the assumptions behind familiar arguments.
entries.zh: 学习哲学让她学会了质疑常见论点背后的假设。

entries.meaningZh: 遵循通常做法或传统方式的。
entries.en: Instead of a conventional desk, he works at a converted kitchen table.
entries.zh: 他使用一张改装的餐桌办公，而没有使用常规书桌。

entries.meaningZh: 可食用的块茎蔬菜，即土豆。
entries.en: A baked potato and a bowl of soup made a satisfying lunch.
entries.zh: 一个烤土豆加一碗汤，组成了一顿让人满足的午餐。

entries.meaningZh: 与自己有血缘或婚姻关系的人。
entries.en: A distant relative sent us photographs of the house our grandparents built.
entries.zh: 一位远亲给我们寄来了祖父母建造的那所房子的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 从疾病、受伤或损失中逐渐恢复的过程。
entries.en: After her injury, the diary became a record of her gradual recovery.
entries.zh: 受伤后，那本日记成了她逐步康复的记录。

entries.meaningZh: 飘浮在空气中或积在表面的细小颗粒。
entries.en: Sunlight revealed clouds of dust above the abandoned theatre seats.
entries.zh: 阳光照出了废弃剧院座椅上方一团团的灰尘。

entries.meaningZh: 出于本人意愿而非强制要求的。
entries.en: Participation is voluntary, and you can leave the activity at any time.
entries.zh: 参与完全自愿，你可以随时退出活动。

entries.meaningZh: 检查设施、活动或工作是否符合要求的人员。
entries.en: The inspector checked the lift before allowing the building to reopen.
entries.zh: 检查员检查了电梯后，才允许这栋建筑重新开放。

entries.meaningZh: 通常较短且前面开襟的外套。
entries.en: He draped his jacket over the chair nearest the fireplace.
entries.zh: 他把夹克搭在了最靠近壁炉的那把椅子上。

entries.meaningZh: 种植作物和饲养牲畜的生产活动。
entries.en: Changes in agriculture have shaped the landscape around this village.
entries.zh: 农业的变化塑造了这个村庄周围的景观。

entries.meaningZh: 一个人故意结束自己生命的行为。
entries.en: The community organised a discussion about suicide prevention and supporting grieving families.
entries.zh: 社区组织了一场讨论，主题是预防自杀和支持遭遇丧亲之痛的家庭。

entries.meaningZh: 数量很多的。
entries.en: Despite numerous invitations, the shy poet rarely attended public events.
entries.zh: 尽管收到过许多邀请，这位腼腆的诗人很少参加公开活动。

entries.meaningZh: 具有某种性质的一类物质。
entries.en: The technician placed a sample of the unknown substance in a sealed container.
entries.zh: 技术员把一份未知物质的样本放进了密封容器。

entries.meaningZh: 在很短时间以后。
entries.en: The manager will join us shortly, once her current call ends.
entries.zh: 经理当前的电话一结束，很快就会来与我们会合。

entries.meaningZh: 对某种活动或事物强烈而持久的热爱。
entries.en: His passion for astronomy began with a borrowed telescope on a camping trip.
entries.zh: 他对天文学的热爱始于露营时借来的一架望远镜。

entries.meaningZh: 自愿提供帮助而通常不领取报酬的人。
entries.en: A volunteer guided us through the maze of corridors in the hospital.
entries.zh: 一名志愿者领着我们穿过医院里迷宫般的走廊。

entries.meaningZh: 在某件事刚开始的时候。
entries.en: I initially mistook the distant lighthouse for a star above the sea.
entries.zh: 我起初把远处的灯塔误认成了海面上方的一颗星星。

entries.meaningZh: 浇在食物上调味的液体或浓汁。
entries.en: The chef served the fish with a delicate lemon sauce.
entries.zh: 厨师给鱼配上了味道清淡的柠檬酱汁。

entries.meaningZh: 身体或心理健康出现问题的状态或疾病。
entries.en: Her illness kept her away from rehearsals for almost a month.
entries.zh: 她因病将近一个月没能参加排练。

entries.meaningZh: 主持宗教仪式并服务信众的神职人员。
entries.en: The priest unlocked the small chapel before the first visitors arrived.
entries.zh: 神父在第一批访客到来前打开了小教堂的门锁。

entries.meaningZh: 用于照明、供热和驱动设备等的电能。
entries.en: The campsite has running water but no electricity after sunset.
entries.zh: 这个营地有自来水，但日落后没有电。

entries.meaningZh: 因违反规则或约定而受到的处罚。
entries.en: There is a small penalty for returning rental equipment after the deadline.
entries.zh: 超过期限归还租赁设备会被收取一小笔罚金。

entries.meaningZh: 略微改变位置或设置，使其合适。
entries.en: Please adjust the microphone so everyone at the back can hear.
entries.zh: 请调整一下麦克风，让坐在后面的人都能听见。

entries.meaningZh: 结束职业生涯，不再继续工作。
entries.en: My mother plans to retire after training the next workshop supervisor.
entries.zh: 我母亲计划在培训好下一任车间主管后退休。

entries.meaningZh: 父母的兄弟或他们姐妹的丈夫。
entries.en: My uncle taught me to repair punctures in his crowded garage.
entries.zh: 我叔叔在他那间堆满东西的车库里教我补车胎。

entries.meaningZh: 只持续一段有限时间的。
entries.en: The school installed a temporary classroom while workers repaired the roof.
entries.zh: 工人维修屋顶期间，学校搭建了一间临时教室。

entries.meaningZh: 能够被眼睛看见的。
entries.en: The island is barely visible from the shore in this mist.
entries.zh: 在这样的薄雾中，从岸边几乎看不见那座岛。

entries.meaningZh: 竞争激烈、需要争取才能成功的。
entries.en: Entry to the orchestra is competitive, with auditions held every spring.
entries.zh: 进入这支管弦乐队的竞争很激烈，每年春天都会举行试奏。

entries.meaningZh: 水果或蔬菜中榨出的液体。
entries.en: A little orange juice brightens the flavour of this carrot soup.
entries.zh: 加一点橙汁能让这道胡萝卜汤的味道更清新。

entries.meaningZh: 一个人或群体拥有的大量钱财和资产。
entries.en: The family used much of its wealth to build public libraries.
entries.zh: 这个家庭用大量家产兴建了公共图书馆。

entries.meaningZh: 山体最高的顶端。
entries.en: Clouds hid the peak until the wind changed in the afternoon.
entries.zh: 云层遮住了山峰，直到下午风向改变后才露出来。

entries.meaningZh: 表示每当某件事发生的时候。
entries.en: Our dog hides under the desk whenever someone starts the vacuum cleaner.
entries.zh: 每当有人启动吸尘器，我们的狗就躲到书桌下面。

entries.meaningZh: 用于科学实验、研究或检测的房间。
entries.en: Visitors must leave their coats outside before entering the laboratory.
entries.zh: 访客进入实验室之前，必须把外套留在外面。

entries.meaningZh: 某一时刻的心理或情绪状态。
entries.en: A walk beside the river usually improves my mood after work.
entries.zh: 下班后沿着河边散步通常能让我心情变好。

entries.meaningZh: 使某种品质、效果或价值得到提升。
entries.en: Soft lighting can enhance the texture of the stone walls.
entries.zh: 柔和的灯光能使石墙的纹理更显突出。

entries.meaningZh: 尚未得到解释、让人疑惑的事情。
entries.en: The mystery of the missing keys ended when we checked the flowerpot.
entries.zh: 我们查看花盆之后，钥匙失踪之谜就解开了。

entries.meaningZh: 缺乏满足基本生活所需钱财的状态。
entries.en: The documentary follows families working to escape poverty in a changing city.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片跟拍了几个在变化中的城市里努力摆脱贫困的家庭。

entries.meaningZh: 代表某种事物或意义的标记。
entries.en: A small bicycle symbol marks the route on the map.
entries.zh: 地图上用一个小自行车符号标出了这条路线。

entries.meaningZh: 两条相交的线或两个平面之间的夹角。
entries.en: Tilt the mirror at an angle to catch the morning light.
entries.zh: 把镜子倾斜一个角度，让它接住清晨的光线。

entries.meaningZh: 持续观察或记录变化情况。
entries.en: Small sensors monitor the temperature inside each refrigerated delivery truck.
entries.zh: 小型传感器持续监测每辆冷藏配送车内部的温度。

entries.meaningZh: 可作为食物或种子使用的豆类籽实。
entries.en: Each child planted a bean in a clear cup to watch it grow.
entries.zh: 每个孩子都在透明杯里种下一颗豆子，观察它生长。

entries.meaningZh: 为互相支持或共同目标建立的联合关系。
entries.en: The two clubs formed an alliance to protect the local woodland.
entries.zh: 这两个社团结成联盟，共同保护当地林地。

entries.meaningZh: 负责指挥军事人员或行动的军官。
entries.en: The commander ordered the unit to wait until the road was clear.
entries.zh: 指挥官命令部队等到道路畅通后再行动。

entries.meaningZh: 与人的思维、情绪和心理状态有关的。
entries.en: The story explores the psychological strain of living under constant observation.
entries.zh: 这个故事探讨了生活在持续监视下所承受的心理压力。

entries.meaningZh: 因受到冒犯或遇到不公而产生的愤怒情绪。
entries.en: His anger faded when he realised the damage had been accidental.
entries.zh: 意识到损坏是意外造成的之后，他的怒气消了。

entries.meaningZh: 带有推进装置、用于攻击目标的武器。
entries.en: The museum displays an unarmed missile beside photographs of its early tests.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一枚未装弹头的导弹，旁边是其早期测试的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 与真实情况不相符的。
entries.en: The rumour gave us false hope that the missing painting had returned.
entries.zh: 那则谣言让我们误以为失踪的画作已经找回，空怀希望。

entries.meaningZh: 细长、可以弯曲的金属丝。
entries.en: She bent a length of wire into a hook for the lantern.
entries.zh: 她把一段金属丝弯成了挂灯笼的钩子。

entries.meaningZh: 因宗教信仰而被视为神圣的。
entries.en: Pilgrims travelled for days to visit the holy site beside the river.
entries.zh: 朝圣者们走了好几天，去探访河边的那处圣地。

entries.meaningZh: 同一次出生的两个孩子中的一个。
entries.en: She is my twin, although we have very different tastes in music.
entries.zh: 她和我是双胞胎，不过我们的音乐品味很不一样。

entries.meaningZh: 经常以某种方式行动或变化的倾向。
entries.en: He has a tendency to whisper when discussing even ordinary surprises.
entries.zh: 他即使谈论普通的惊喜，也往往会压低声音。

entries.meaningZh: 用于特定用途的房间或封闭空间。
entries.en: The stone chamber beneath the castle once stored grain for winter.
entries.zh: 城堡下面的石室曾经用来储存过冬的粮食。

entries.meaningZh: 定期支付的房屋或物品使用费。
entries.en: Our rent includes water, but we pay separately for electricity.
entries.zh: 我们的房租包含水费，但电费需要另付。

entries.meaningZh: 达到要求、能够被接受的。
entries.en: A handwritten note is acceptable if you cannot print the form.
entries.zh: 如果无法打印表格，手写说明也可以接受。

entries.meaningZh: 提供诊断或治疗等医疗服务的机构。
entries.en: The village clinic shares its waiting room with a community pharmacy.
entries.zh: 村里的诊所与一家社区药房共用候诊室。

entries.meaningZh: 曾在军队服役的人。
entries.en: A local veteran brought his wartime letters to the school history project.
entries.zh: 一位当地退伍军人把他战时的信件带来，供学校的历史课题使用。

entries.meaningZh: 鼻子能够感受到的气味。
entries.en: The smell of fresh coffee drifted upstairs before anyone called me.
entries.zh: 还没等有人叫我，新煮咖啡的香味就飘上了楼。

entries.meaningZh: 为游览或度假而到外地的人。
entries.en: A lost tourist asked whether the castle was within walking distance.
entries.zh: 一位迷路的游客问，步行能否到达那座城堡。

entries.meaningZh: 由奶油加工成的黄色脂肪食品，即黄油。
entries.en: Leave the butter on the counter until it softens enough to spread.
entries.zh: 把黄油放在台面上，等它变软到可以涂抹。

entries.meaningZh: 设有洗浴或如厕设施的房间。
entries.en: The bathroom window opens onto a tiny courtyard filled with ferns.
entries.zh: 浴室的窗户朝向一个长满蕨类植物的小庭院。

entries.meaningZh: 由两种或更多成分混合而成的东西。
entries.en: Stir the mixture slowly until all the flour has disappeared.
entries.zh: 慢慢搅拌混合物，直到看不到干面粉。

entries.meaningZh: 直接面对或处理令人困难的事情。
entries.en: The report forced the council to confront years of neglected maintenance.
entries.zh: 这份报告迫使地方议会正视多年来被忽视的维护问题。

entries.meaningZh: 忍住想做某事的冲动。
entries.en: I could not resist buying a second slice of that lemon cake.
entries.zh: 我忍不住又买了一块那种柠檬蛋糕。

entries.meaningZh: 经常按相同顺序进行的一套日常活动。
entries.en: Reading the newspaper over tea is part of my morning routine.
entries.zh: 边喝茶边看报纸是我每天早晨的惯例之一。

entries.meaningZh: 出众到值得特别注意或赞叹的。
entries.en: The young pianist showed remarkable calm when the lights suddenly failed.
entries.zh: 灯光突然熄灭时，那位年轻钢琴家表现出了非凡的镇定。

entries.meaningZh: 在年龄、地位或能力等方面相近的人。
entries.en: Each student discussed the draft with a peer before submitting it.
entries.zh: 每位学生在提交草稿之前，都与一位同学进行了讨论。

entries.meaningZh: 某个机构或组织的全体工作人员。
entries.en: Only authorised personnel may enter the control room during the performance.
entries.zh: 演出期间，只有获授权的工作人员可以进入控制室。

entries.meaningZh: 规划物品外观、结构或形式的人。
entries.en: The designer created chairs that stack neatly in small apartments.
entries.zh: 这位设计师设计的椅子可以在小公寓里整齐堆叠。

entries.meaningZh: 允许或可能达到的最高程度的。
entries.en: The maximum weight for a suitcase is printed beside the check-in desk.
entries.zh: 行李箱的重量上限印在值机柜台旁边。

entries.meaningZh: 桌椅、床、柜子等室内使用的物品。
entries.en: Most of our furniture came from relatives who were moving house.
entries.zh: 我们的大部分家具来自当时正在搬家的亲戚。

entries.meaningZh: 想法、表现或能力非常出色的。
entries.en: Her brilliant solution used a bicycle wheel to lift the heavy bucket.
entries.zh: 她那个绝妙的办法是用自行车轮来提起沉重的水桶。

entries.meaningZh: 系在腰间以固定衣物或装饰的带子。
entries.en: He tightened his belt before climbing the ladder to the attic.
entries.zh: 他在爬梯子上阁楼之前系紧了腰带。

entries.meaningZh: 人们进入另一个国家定居的行为或现象。
entries.en: The exhibition explores how immigration changed the city's food and music.
entries.zh: 这个展览探讨了移民如何改变这座城市的饮食和音乐。

entries.meaningZh: 每年与某人出生日期相同的那一天。
entries.en: For his birthday, we collected stories from friends he had not seen in years.
entries.zh: 为庆祝他的生日，我们收集了他多年未见的朋友们讲述的故事。

entries.meaningZh: 停止工作后不再从事原职业的生活阶段。
entries.en: In retirement, she finally found time to learn the cello.
entries.zh: 退休后，她终于有时间学习大提琴了。

entries.meaningZh: 用来输送液体或气体的中空长管。
entries.en: A leaking pipe beneath the sink had soaked the cleaning cloths.
entries.zh: 水槽下方的一根漏水管把清洁布都浸湿了。

entries.meaningZh: 强调数量很小或事物不过如此的。
entries.en: The repair took a mere ten minutes once we found the correct tool.
entries.zh: 找到合适的工具后，维修只花了十分钟。

entries.meaningZh: 年龄在十三至十九岁之间的人。
entries.en: As a teenager, he spent his weekends sketching boats at the harbour.
entries.zh: 十几岁时，他经常周末在港口画船的速写。

entries.meaningZh: 包含相关各方面、覆盖全面的。
entries.en: The guide offers a comprehensive list of wheelchair-accessible walking routes around the city.
entries.zh: 这本指南全面列出了城市周边适合轮椅使用者通行的步行路线。

entries.meaningZh: 代表国家、组织或传递信号的旗帜。
entries.en: A red flag above the beach warned swimmers to stay ashore.
entries.zh: 海滩上方的一面红旗警示游泳者留在岸上。

entries.meaningZh: 一种通常呈圆形、果肉脆甜的水果，即苹果。
entries.en: She sliced an apple into thin pieces for the children's snack.
entries.zh: 她把一个苹果切成薄片，给孩子们当点心。

entries.meaningZh: 用很轻的声音说话。
entries.en: Please whisper while we pass the room where the baby sleeps.
entries.zh: 经过宝宝睡觉的房间时，请轻声说话。

entries.meaningZh: 颈部内部连接口鼻与食道、气管的部位。
entries.en: He cleared his throat before reading the unexpected announcement aloud.
entries.zh: 他清了清嗓子，然后大声宣读了那则出人意料的通知。

entries.meaningZh: 买卖某类商品的商人。
entries.en: An antique dealer recognised the maker's mark beneath the dusty vase.
entries.zh: 一位古董商认出了那个积满灰尘的花瓶底部的制造者标记。

entries.meaningZh: 围绕地球运行的天然卫星，即月亮。
entries.en: The moon rose above the hills as we packed away our fishing rods.
entries.zh: 我们收起鱼竿时，月亮从山丘上方升了起来。

entries.meaningZh: 用木材制成的。
entries.en: The wooden gate swelled in the rain and became difficult to close.
entries.zh: 那扇木门淋雨后膨胀了，变得很难关上。

entries.meaningZh: 雇员定期领取的固定工作报酬。
entries.en: The advertisement lists the salary but says little about the working hours.
entries.zh: 招聘广告列出了薪资，却几乎没提工作时间。

entries.meaningZh: 观察事件过程、通常不直接参与的人。
entries.en: An independent observer watched the count and recorded any disputed votes.
entries.zh: 一名独立观察员观看了计票过程，并记录了所有有争议的选票。

entries.meaningZh: 为获取食物或原料而种植的农作物。
entries.en: The farmer chose a crop that could survive the valley's short summers.
entries.zh: 这位农民选择了一种能适应山谷短暂夏季的作物。

entries.meaningZh: 行走、工作或事情发展的速度。
entries.en: We slowed our pace so the youngest walkers could keep up.
entries.zh: 我们放慢脚步，让年纪最小的步行者也能跟上。

entries.meaningZh: 对可能发生的事情感到担忧不安。
entries.en: His anxiety about the audition eased after a friendly conversation backstage.
entries.zh: 在后台进行了一番友好的交谈后，他对试演的焦虑减轻了。

entries.meaningZh: 允许某人做某事的同意。
entries.en: We asked the owner for permission to photograph the courtyard.
entries.zh: 我们向主人请求拍摄庭院的许可。

entries.meaningZh: 利用专业知识向别人提供建议的人。
entries.en: The consultant suggested rearranging the kitchen before buying any new equipment.
entries.zh: 顾问建议先重新布置厨房，再考虑购买新设备。

entries.meaningZh: 通过邮政系统递送的信件和包裹。
entries.en: Please collect our mail while we are away visiting my parents.
entries.zh: 我们外出探望父母期间，请帮忙收一下邮件。

entries.meaningZh: 负责领导一座城市或城镇的市长。
entries.en: The mayor joined residents in planting trees beside the new playground.
entries.zh: 市长与居民一起在新游乐场旁种树。

entries.meaningZh: 呈较浅的红色的，即粉红色的。
entries.en: Small pink flowers appeared along the hedge after the first warm week.
entries.zh: 第一个温暖的星期过后，树篱沿线开出了粉红色的小花。

entries.meaningZh: 从事警务工作的男性警员。
entries.en: A policeman directed traffic around the broken water main on our street.
entries.zh: 一名男警察引导车流绕过我们街上破裂的自来水主管。

entries.meaningZh: 火车站供旅客上下车的站台。
entries.en: Passengers crowded onto the platform as the last train approached.
entries.zh: 末班火车驶近时，乘客们涌上了站台。

entries.meaningZh: 用来遮挡窗户或分隔空间的帘子。
entries.en: A thin curtain softened the sunlight falling across the baby's cot.
entries.zh: 一层薄窗帘柔化了洒在婴儿床上的阳光。

entries.meaningZh: 在历史上具有重大意义的。
entries.en: The museum preserves the pen used to sign the historic agreement.
entries.zh: 博物馆保存着签署那份历史性协议时用过的笔。

entries.meaningZh: 两队轮流击球和投球的一种运动，即板球。
entries.en: We spent Sunday watching cricket from a shady spot near the clubhouse.
entries.zh: 星期天，我们在俱乐部会所附近一处阴凉的地方看板球。

entries.meaningZh: 用秤测量某物的重量。
entries.en: Remember to weigh the empty bowl before adding the flour.
entries.zh: 记得先称空碗的重量，再放入面粉。

entries.meaningZh: 把设备放到合适的位置并使其能使用。
entries.en: An electrician will install the new ceiling lights on Friday morning.
entries.zh: 一位电工将在星期五上午安装新的吸顶灯。

entries.meaningZh: 病原体侵入身体并引发的感染。
entries.en: The doctor examined the wound for signs of infection before changing the dressing.
entries.zh: 医生在更换敷料之前，检查了伤口是否有感染迹象。
